stories.title: Bihar restricts social media use in schools
stories.summary: The Bihar government has banned students and teachers from filming social media reels during class hours without permission. This follows a new formal dress code for staff. The state manages over 76,000 schools, which have recently made headlines for reasons the government is now attempting to regulate.

stories.title: Bihar bans unauthorised visitors from school campuses
stories.summary: The Bihar Education Department has prohibited outsiders from entering school campuses during class hours. This follows a directive banning teachers and students from shooting social media videos during school time. The department is currently formalising conduct rules for its 76,000 government schools.

stories.title: BJP dismisses opposition concerns over electoral roll revision
stories.summary: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav has accused opposition parties of spreading anarchy by questioning the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. He described the process as a routine constitutional exercise and announced a BJP campaign to dispel confusion. The party maintains that democratic processes are being misunderstood.

stories.title: Bihar mandates bank accounts for government school students
stories.summary: The Bihar Education Department now requires all government school students to maintain birth certificates in school records and hold individual or joint bank accounts. The move aligns with a 2014 central government financial inclusion initiative. Every child is now expected to be a bank account holder.

stories.title: NDA reviews performance in Bihar legislative council polls
stories.summary: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary convened a meeting of NDA leaders to review results from the recent legislative council elections. The NDA secured three seats, while the RJD won two and the Jan Suraaj Party claimed one. The coalition continues to assess its standing in the state.

stories.title: TNCC president alleges efforts to destabilise government
stories.summary: TNCC president Manickam Tagore has alleged that opposition parties are attempting to poach MLAs to destabilise the TVK-led government. He defended the administration as honest and clean, noting that senior leaders from the DMK, AIADMK and BJP have repeatedly questioned the government's stability over recent months.

stories.title: Amit Shah defends Parliament as forum for debate
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has criticised Rahul Gandhi for taking political confrontations to the streets instead of using Parliament. Shah described the legislature as the supreme forum for debate and accused the Congress of turning walkouts and protests into a standard political culture.

stories.title: Congress frames protests as fight for democracy
stories.summary: Congress general secretary KC Venugopal stated that the party's protests against the Chief Election Commissioner are intended to restore democracy. He reiterated that the public wants Rahul Gandhi to be Prime Minister, while accusing the Centre of using democratic institutions for anti-democratic actions.

stories.title: AAP criticises Rahul Gandhi for remarks on Bhagwant Mann
stories.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has condemned Rahul Gandhi for suggesting that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was intoxicated during parliamentary proceedings. AAP leaders described the comments as below-the-belt and unbecoming of a senior politician. The exchange has further strained relations between the two parties.

stories.title: Youth Congress suspends members for missing rally
stories.summary: The Indian Youth Congress has suspended 215 office-bearers across eight states for failing to attend an INDIA bloc rally against the Chief Election Commissioner. The organisation used a mobile application to monitor attendance at the event, which was described as a major mobilisation for the opposition.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav to skip 2027 UP assembly contest
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav will not contest the 2027 assembly elections, opting to focus on statewide campaigning. He cited past electoral success as a reason for his decision, noting that he secured a majority in 2012 while serving as a Lok Sabha member.

stories.title: Congress and SP clash over potential alliance addition
stories.summary: Tensions are rising between the Congress and Samajwadi Party in Uttar Pradesh regarding the potential inclusion of Swami Prasad Maurya in the INDIA bloc. While Maurya met with Congress leadership, Akhilesh Yadav has ruled out his entry into the alliance, complicating pre-election coordination.

stories.title: Delhi air quality remains in severe category
stories.summary: Delhi air quality remained in the very poor category on Friday, with several areas recording severe pollution levels. The 24-hour average Air Quality Index reached 391 at 9 a.m. according to the Central Pollution Control Board. North Indian cities are currently experiencing similar conditions.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at Karol Bagh commercial building
stories.summary: A fire destroyed a four-storey commercial building in Gaffar Market early Friday morning. Authorities believe the blaze, which originated in a mobile accessories shop, may have been caused by overheating batteries. No injuries were reported, and the fire has been extinguished by emergency services.

stories.title: Madhya Pradesh approves greenfield corridor project
stories.summary: The Madhya Pradesh government has approved a ₹63,296 crore plan to construct five greenfield expressway corridors spanning 1,398 km. The project, reviewed by the state road development corporation, aims to improve connectivity across the state. Consultants are currently preparing feasibility reports for the proposed routes.

stories.title: Maharashtra allocates funds for primitive tribes
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has set aside ₹160 crore in its 2026-27 budget for the development of primitive tribes and the Pardhi community. The package includes funding for basic amenities and individual benefit schemes, with the government providing full grants for the planned initiatives.

stories.title: Traffic restrictions implemented near Anand Vihar
stories.summary: Delhi Traffic Police has introduced diversions around Anand Vihar ISBT to manage festive crowds through November 15. The restrictions aim to prevent congestion during the upcoming Diwali and Chhath Puja period. Commuters are advised to expect delays on major routes near the transport hub.

stories.title: Seven killed in Jharkhand road accident
stories.summary: Seven people, including three children and three women, were killed after being struck by a truck in Khunti district on Thursday night. Police reported that six victims died at the scene, while one died in the hospital. An investigation into the incident is underway.

stories.title: West Bengal announces new investment policy
stories.summary: The BJP government in West Bengal has launched an investment policy offering up to 120 percent assistance for fixed capital investment in plant and machinery. The policy, effective from May 2026, prioritises industries that employ more women and establishes fixed timelines for project approvals. Policy shifts are underway.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA seizes over 3,000 tonnes of food stock
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration seized food stock worth 63.45 crore rupees and suspended 954 licences during a statewide enforcement drive ending November 3. Officials inspected 9,667 establishments and issued thousands of improvement notices. The settlement, unlike some orders, arrived.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA cancels 122 drug and cosmetic licences
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration cancelled 122 licences and suspended 422 others following 1,986 inspections in October. The department issued 674 notices to drug manufacturing and sales establishments. Regulatory action is now a monthly occurrence.

stories.title: ED arrests two in 400 crore rupee cyber fraud case
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate arrested two individuals in a 400 crore rupee cyber fraud network involving investment and job scams. The agency identified 600 cybercrime complaints linked to the group, which allegedly laundered money through mule accounts and cryptocurrency wallets. The investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: Delhi police implement traffic curbs near Anand Vihar
stories.summary: Delhi Traffic Police have introduced special arrangements and diversions around the Anand Vihar bus terminal from November 5 to 15. The measures aim to manage the expected surge in passenger movement during the festive season. The police have advised the public to expect potential commotion.

stories.title: Two dead in Chawri Bazar building collapse
stories.summary: Two people died after a building collapsed in Chawri Bazar while a concrete slab was being laid. The Delhi Chief Minister has ordered the suspension of two municipal engineers and an FIR against the contractor. Officials have appealed to citizens to follow building safety standards.

stories.title: Hyderabad startup unveils private space debris facility
stories.summary: Cosmoserve Space has opened Base 1, a facility equipped with microgravity simulation and space-vision systems for satellite servicing and debris recovery. The company claims it is India's first private facility of its kind, and only the sixth globally. The space sector is now open for private recovery.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu rejects claims of lost investments
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu Industries Department has dismissed opposition claims that the state lost three auto-component suppliers to Andhra Pradesh. Officials described the narrative as a distortion of basic industrial economics. The investments were not for Tamil Nadu to begin with, according to the state.

stories.title: Indian GCCs expected to add 35,000 jobs in 2027
stories.summary: India is projected to add up to 35,000 jobs in greenfield global capability centres next year, according to estimates by an Accenture-backed firm. Mid-sized American companies are exploring India for tech team expansions due to tighter H1B laws. The caveat emptor is that growth depends on talent.

stories.title: TReDS volumes jump 36 percent on festive demand
stories.summary: Invoice discounting platforms recorded a 36 percent increase in financing activity during August and September, reaching 75,788 crore rupees. Small businesses turned to the platforms to fund inventory and working capital needs during the festive season. The system is seeing a seasonal boost.

stories.title: TReDS sees a festive boost, Nykaa’s growth strategy

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz announces 200 crore rupee India investment
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has announced an additional 200 crore rupee investment in India, bringing its cumulative total to 3,200 crore rupees. The company sold 15,190 vehicles in the first nine months of 2026. Management says the country could warrant an enhanced manufacturing commitment as wealth creation expands.

stories.title: Emami reports pick up in winter demand
stories.summary: Emami reported encouraging signs in its winter product portfolio as trade sales show improvement. The company has implemented price hikes to offset rising input costs and is monitoring inflation levels. Management expects to sustain growth momentum in the second half of the fiscal year.

stories.title: SIAM expects auto sales momentum to continue
stories.summary: Automobile sales surged 20 percent in the six months ending September 30, according to SIAM. The industry body expects full-year growth to be fuelled by GST reforms, festive demand, and infrastructure spending. New launches and alternate fuels are currently driving the passenger vehicle segment.

stories.title: Green crackers fail to meet buyer expectations
stories.summary: Traders report slower business as the market shifts toward green crackers, which are intended to reduce emissions and noise. While firecracker stalls have appeared across Hyderabad, some buyers are reportedly seeking more impact for their money. The market is undergoing a gradual, less noisy transition.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh steps up pollution monitoring
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board has directed district authorities to enforce environmental regulations and monitor pollution levels during Deepavali. Joint inspection teams have been tasked with preventing the sale and transport of banned firecrackers. Officials are monitoring air and noise levels across the state.

stories.title: Doctors warn of injuries from homemade explosives
stories.summary: AIIMS Delhi has recorded a rise in burn injuries linked to homemade explosive mixtures containing potassium chlorate and sulphur. Doctors have called for preventive measures as these substances emerge as alternatives to conventional firecrackers. The injuries are associated with the growing use of alternative mixtures.

stories.title: Gurugram residents report open burning of scrap
stories.summary: Resident group CleanAirBharat has written to pollution authorities regarding the recurring open burning of metal filters and scrap materials by dealers in Gurugram. The group is calling for a systemic response to the practice, noting that isolated inspections have so far failed to curb the activity.

stories.title: Delhi government reports construction violations
stories.summary: The Delhi government has issued 66 show-cause notices and 2 closure directions following inspections at 1,232 construction sites. Officials found violations at 203 locations, with 77 sites flagged on Wednesday alone. The government has imposed 59.15 lakh in environmental compensation during the first four days of winter restrictions.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu land conversion rules face scrutiny
stories.summary: Environmental group Poovulagin Nanbargal has raised concerns over amendments to Tamil Nadu land conversion rules. The organisation claims the changes weaken scrutiny by removing the requirement for District Collectors to personally inspect agricultural land before approving its conversion for non-agricultural use. The government says it is simplifying procedures.

stories.title: Anbumani alleges marshland project irregularities
stories.summary: PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss has alleged a massive scam involving projects in the Pallikaranai marshland. He claims officials are diluting environmental safeguards to favour developers, citing the construction of a road and walking track funded by a 21.5-crore World Bank loan. He has called for an investigation.

stories.title: Residents report green water in Erode district
stories.summary: Residents and farmers in Erode district are reporting that Cauvery river water has turned green, causing skin irritation for those who bathe in it. Locals suspect industrial effluents discharged upstream are responsible for the contamination. The river flows through several industrial areas before reaching the affected sites.

stories.title: Musk removes pro-Republican posts from X
stories.summary: Elon Musk has deleted posts on X urging voters to support Republican candidates, including a pinned message from October 29. The removal occurred around the time Democrat James Talarico won a Texas Senate seat. Musk's chatbot Grok confirmed the deletion when asked by a user.

stories.title: US markets record significant losses
stories.summary: The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones all recorded their largest one-day percentage drops since April 2025. The Nasdaq closed more than 10 percent below its October record high as AI-related fears wiped out 3 trillion in market value. The Russell 2000 also fell 4.4 percent.

stories.title: Trump designates Oval Office a national monument
stories.summary: President Trump has issued an order designating the Oval Office as a national monument to prevent future occupants from altering the space. Trump stated the move will ensure the office cannot be touched or destroyed by people who might want to build something in a different shape.

stories.title: Eisenkot considered for Israeli government formation
stories.summary: Gadi Eisenkot has emerged as a potential candidate to form an Israeli government following the October 27 election. President Isaac Herzog is currently holding consultations after neither Eisenkot nor Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu secured a majority. Herzog will decide who receives the mandate to form a government.

stories.title: Trump blames election results for market downturn
stories.summary: President Trump has attributed the recent stock market decline to Democratic victories in the 2026 midterm elections. In a post on Truth Social, he described the sell-off as one of the worst in history and expressed concern over the impact on Americans' retirement savings.

stories.title: Hegseth faces impeachment pressure
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing calls for impeachment from Congressional Democrats following Republican midterm losses. Critics have targeted his conduct of the Iran war and the firing of military officers. President Trump has defended Hegseth despite intensifying pressure from opponents and some members of his own party.

stories.title: India maintains bipartisan view of US midterms
stories.summary: Experts suggest that India's relationship with the US will remain anchored by a bipartisan consensus that has persisted since 2000. While some Republicans have criticised India over foreign funding restrictions, Democrats have previously raised concerns regarding human rights. Both parties continue to deepen ties across various sectors.

stories.title: Hegseth impeachment vote possible next week
stories.summary: Representative Thomas Massie plans to trigger a vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth when Congress returns next week. Many Republicans are reportedly concerned that Hegseth convinced President Trump to attack Iran without an exit strategy. The move follows significant Republican losses in the midterm elections.

stories.title: Tariff relief for Indian auto parts remains uncertain
stories.summary: Industry executives suggest that major changes to US tariffs on Indian auto parts are unlikely despite the Democratic sweep in Congress. The President retains veto power over trade legislation, and trade talks have remained stalled since earlier this year. A two-thirds majority would be required to overturn a veto.

stories.title: UK launches AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.summary: The United Kingdom has established an AI Biosecurity Lab, backed by 300 million in funding and commitments. The lab aims to accelerate medical research while ensuring AI is not used to develop biological weapons. It is the first facility of its kind in the world.

stories.title: Cert-In releases AI security guidelines
stories.summary: Cert-In has issued a 107-page document outlining security auditing guidelines for AI systems in India. The framework applies to all organisations developing or deploying AI, including foreign companies handling Indian data. The agency stated that compliance requirements apply uniformly, with no exemptions for smaller firms or startups.

stories.title: Cert-In warns of AI-driven financial cyberattacks
stories.summary: Cert-In and the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre have warned financial institutions of a campaign involving AI agents used to facilitate unauthorised fund transfers. The agencies reported that stolen funds are quickly moved through mule accounts and withdrawn via IMPS and NEFT systems.

stories.title: Republicans request briefing from Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: House committee chairs have requested a closed-door briefing from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding reports that a former executive of a partner company is under investigation. US authorities are scrutinising whether the company helped Beijing access restricted AI chips. The briefing is scheduled for November 18.

stories.title: AI gains fail to cool rising staff costs at Indian IT services firms
stories.summary: Top Indian IT services firms are spending more on premium talent, reskilling, and compensation, according to industry experts. Although companies claim artificial intelligence and automation are changing the traditional labour-intensive model, they have yet to lower employee costs. The model remains as labour-intensive as the budget allows.

stories.title: AI turns cyber threat into boardroom crisis
stories.summary: The weaponisation of artificial intelligence is allowing criminals to exploit vulnerabilities in legacy technology systems, according to industry reports. With data breaches hitting major institutions and millions of internet infrastructure points at risk, cybersecurity consultants are seeing a fresh wave of mandates. Boards are now managing the fallout.

stories.title: Wall Street loses $2 trillion as AI and chip stocks plunge
stories.summary: Major US stock indexes suffered heavy losses on Thursday, with the Nasdaq Composite falling 4.20 percent. The sell-off has renewed focus on Michael Burry's warnings regarding AI valuations and infrastructure returns. Thursday's market performance does not prove his prediction right, but it has certainly made the math look different.

stories.title: Renewable energy could save India $240 billion in fuel imports by 2030
stories.summary: India could save nearly $240 billion in coal and natural gas import costs by 2030 by expanding renewable energy capacity, the International Energy Agency reports. Annual savings are projected to reach $35 billion, potentially exceeding the country's current fossil fuel import bill. The sun is currently free of charge.

stories.title: J&K health sector receives shot in arm as Union Minister sets AIIMS deadline
stories.summary: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda has set a March 2027 deadline for the completion of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Awantipora. While Phase-I buildings are finished, the minister has asked agencies to maintain momentum. The project remains a priority, provided the calendar is followed.

stories.title: Union health ministry clears administrative pendency
stories.summary: The Union health ministry says it has achieved 100 percent of its targets under a recent cleanliness campaign. The ministry weeded out 1.20 lakh physical files and cleared 5.82 lakh square feet of office space. It also generated over 1 crore rupees by disposing of scrap and e-waste.

stories.title: Advanced technology for knee replacement surgery helps faster recovery
stories.summary: Naruvi Hospitals says its use of the American-made CORI robot allows patients to recover from joint replacement surgery in one month, compared to the traditional three-month period. The hospital claims the technology also minimizes pain. Faster recovery is now being marketed as a standard feature of the hardware.

stories.title: Court permits termination of pregnancy in case of foetal abnormalities
stories.summary: The Madras High Court has permitted a woman to terminate her pregnancy after discovering the foetus suffered from substantial abnormalities. Justice P.T. Asha observed that the court must bow down to the mother's decision, noting the child would not lead a normal life. The law has acknowledged the choice.

stories.title: No major outbreak of veterinary diseases reported in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Minister S. Kamali says there is no major outbreak of veterinary diseases in the state. The minister also advised that children should avoid bursting crackers near cattle during Deepavali to prevent distress. Regular vaccination camps are currently being conducted across the state.

stories.title: Health Minister demands vigilance probe into surgical block construction
stories.summary: Health Minister K. Muraleedharan has requested a vigilance probe into the 270 crore rupee surgical block at Kottayam Medical College. The minister cited allegations of technical flaws, financial misconduct, and lapses in supervision. A technical committee has been tasked with assessing if the building is safe to use.

stories.title: UNESCO adds ancient Indian texts to memory register
stories.summary: The Mahabharata, Arthashastra, and Rajatarangini have been added to the UNESCO Memory of the World register. The full details regarding this recognition are currently unavailable due to server access restrictions. The history remains accessible elsewhere.

stories.title: India plans to clean up orbital trash by 2030
stories.summary: India has announced a plan to address orbital debris by 2030 under a project titled Swachh Space. Further details on the operational strategy for this cleanup are currently unavailable due to server access restrictions. The orbit is currently waiting for the broom.

stories.title: CMFRI maps 161 marine mammal strandings along Indian coast
stories.summary: The Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute documented 161 marine mammal strandings during 2024-25, with Goa reporting the highest number of cases. The institute has developed a GIS-based map to track patterns and aid conservation. Humpback dolphins accounted for the majority of the recorded strandings.

stories.title: MSRTC announces ex-gratia grant for 83,000 officers
stories.summary: Maharashtra Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik has announced a 10,000 rupee ex-gratia grant for MSRTC employees, alongside a dearness allowance hike to 60 percent. The move will cost the corporation 160 crore rupees. The minister stated that employees should not be deprived of the joy of the festival.

stories.title: MSRTC announces Diwali bonus for 83,000 employees
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation will provide a 10,000 rupee Diwali bonus to 83,000 employees. The state-run transport body, which operates 15,000 buses, also increased dearness allowance to 60 percent. Eligible staff will receive an additional 12,500 rupee advance to cover holiday expenses.

stories.title: Delhi minister apologises for vehicle entry curbs
stories.summary: Delhi environment minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa has apologised for the inconvenience caused by restrictions on non-BS-IV vehicles. The curbs, part of the winter action plan, will remain in force until January 31, 2027. The minister described the measures as necessary for the well-being of the city's residents.

stories.title: AAP and BJP clash over air quality video
stories.summary: A video released by an AAP leader regarding air quality in Delhi and Punjab has sparked a fresh political face-off with the BJP. Access to the specific details of the confrontation is currently restricted. The air remains unchanged by the debate.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi rally features tribute to Sidhu Moosewala
stories.summary: A recent rally led by Rahul Gandhi included a reserved chair for the father of the late singer Sidhu Moosewala. The event featured songs and remembrances. Further analysis of the political implications is currently unavailable due to server access restrictions.

stories.title: Nithya Raman's Chennai connection
stories.summary: Before becoming the first Indian-origin mayor of Los Angeles, Nithya Raman worked as an urban planner in Chennai. Residents of Nanganallur recall her mapping traffic snarls and studying local civic problems. The city has since moved on to larger maps, but the traffic remains.

stories.title: Tamizh Padam 3 begins production
stories.summary: Y Not Studios announced that the third instalment of the Tamizh Padam franchise has started filming. Director CS Amudhan and lead actor Shiva are returning for the spoof comedy. The new poster labels Shiva an Intergalactic Superstar, suggesting the parody of cinema tropes will now leave the planet.

stories.title: Suriya's Scene builds Deepavali anticipation
stories.summary: Suriya's upcoming film Scene is generating significant interest as a major Deepavali release in Tamil Nadu. Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the film follows the actor's recent box office successes. The industry is waiting to see if the film completes a hat-trick of hits for the year.
